notes: Woodland and antiquarian: the Court of Truth's old oak and stone, forest relics, one great ancient tree. Core pieces are the humble woodland furnishings; the rares are the Great Yew (in Felucca its crown is bare, so it reads as a vast gnarled ancient), a judge's stone chair and ceremonial hangings.

entries.why: The town's namesake table in pale yew wood
Moss-grown stack of old books, the antiquarian's shelf
A tall woodland fern for the glade
The Great Yew itself, 10x10; bare gnarled giant in Felucca
Carved stone seat fit for a Court of Truth judge
Tapestry of six emblems, a scholar's heraldic hanging
Midnight lace hanging, a ceremonial banner of the old forest court
Gnarled oak with sprawling bare limbs, a forest relic
